Package io.webagent4j.recording

Class WorkflowRecorderV2

java.lang.Object
io.webagent4j.recording.WorkflowRecorderV2
public final class WorkflowRecorderV2 extends Object
Captures a WorkflowExecution (a WorkflowResult plus its WorkflowExecutionTree, as returned by WorkflowEngine#executeWithTree) into an immutable WorkflowRecordingV2, alongside the same execution's WorkflowExecutionPlan - the Recording V2 counterpart of WorkflowRecorder.

plan must describe the exact workflow that produced execution: both are ordinary caller-supplied arguments, obtained independently (typically WorkflowPlanner.plan(workflow) and engine.executeWithTree(workflow, inputs) against the very same workflow instance), and this recorder does not itself execute anything or derive one from the other. A step whose result reports a published output but whose plan carries no corresponding declared output is rejected outright (see recordStep(io.webagent4j.workflow.WorkflowStepResult, java.util.Optional<io.webagent4j.workflow.WorkflowPlanOutput>)) rather than silently recording no output, since silently doing so could misrepresent whether - and under what secret classification - a value was actually published.

Secret-safety boundary: identical in scope to WorkflowRecorder's - this recorder never reads WorkflowInputs, raw WorkflowOutputs, WorkflowResult#output(WorkflowVariable), ActionResult.value, action observations or diagnostics, raw Throwable data, or the workflow secret registry. A published output's WorkflowPlanOutput.secret() classification is recorded - never the value itself, which this recorder never touches - taken from plan's own already-static, already-safe structural description rather than from anything execution-observed. Condition descriptions and failure messages copied from WorkflowResult/WorkflowExecutionTree have already been redacted by WorkflowEngine.

  • Method Details

    • record

      public WorkflowRecordingV2 record(RecordingId recordingId, Instant capturedAt, WorkflowExecutionPlan plan, WorkflowExecution execution)
      Records execution (captured against plan's own workflow) as an immutable WorkflowRecordingV2.
      Parameters:
      recordingId - the non-sensitive caller-supplied identifier, persisted verbatim
      capturedAt - the caller-supplied capture time
      plan - the executed workflow's own structural plan
      execution - the workflow execution outcome to record
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a step in execution published an output plan does not declare, or if plan/execution otherwise cannot form a valid WorkflowRecordingV2 together (see RecordingV2Invariants)
